Libraries, tech firms, data teams and research bodies pay for organised information.

blocks.heading: What AI Is Actually Changing Here

items.text: For the Information Science Engineering side, AI and machine learning are not a threat to this track, they are the growth area: an ISE graduate who specifically builds ML and data-engineering skills is positioned well ahead of one who treats the degree as generic, undifferentiated software work.
Right now, an ISE student should start with a foundational ML/data course and a small applied project; an LIS student should get hands-on with at least one AI-assisted cataloguing or discovery tool.

Freelance knowledge-management and taxonomy consulting, helping companies organise internal wikis, document systems, and search, is a genuine, currently underused ownership path for LIS-trained professionals, and pays better per hour than most entry-level library roles.

blocks.sourceSectionTitle: Two unrelated fields sharing one name

rows: Information Science Engineering (ISE)

A B.E./B.Tech engineering branch (most established under VTU and other Karnataka universities), teaching largely the same core as Computer Science: programming, databases, networks, and software systems, with a lean toward information systems and data.
Software developer, data engineer, systems analyst, the same employer pool as Computer Science graduates
Library and Information Science (LIS or MLIS)

A separate humanities-and-science field covering how information is organised, catalogued, preserved, and retrieved, in physical libraries and increasingly in digital archives and knowledge-management systems.
Librarian, archivist, knowledge manager, digital-repository specialist, records manager
